Based on the video, you can set Bing as your default search engine on Google Chrome by following these steps:

1. In the top right corner of the Google Chrome window, click on the three dots icon to open the menu.
2. From the dropdown menu, select and click on "Settings". This will open the Chrome Settings page.
3. On the left-side navigation menu, locate and click on "Search engine".
4. On the Search engine page, find the option "Search engine used in the address bar" and click on the dropdown box next to it (which currently displays your current default search engine).
5. From the dropdown menu, select "Bing" to set it as your main search engine.

To make Bing your main search engine on Google Chrome, follow these step-by-step instructions:

1. Click on the three vertical dots (Customize and control Google Chrome) located in the upper-right corner of the browser window. This will open a dropdown menu.
2. From the dropdown menu, click on "Settings". This will open the Chrome Settings page in a new tab.
3. In the left-hand sidebar of the Settings page, click on "Search engine".
4. Under the "Search engine" section on the right, look for "Search engine used in the address bar" and click on the "Change" button located next to "Google".
5. A popup window titled "Search engine" will appear, listing popular search engines in your region.
6. Select "Microsoft Bing" by clicking the radio button next to it.
7. Click the "Set as default" button at the bottom of the popup to save your choice.
